biod: Add new fingerprint firmware updater Add new bio_fw_updater utility which replaces the private-overlay per-board fp_updater.sh from chromeos-firmware-fpmcu-BOARD packages. This new updater adds the following notable functionality to the update process: * Decodes RO and RW versions from packaged firmware files. This means that the RO version does not need to be hardcoded in a board specific shell script and the RW version does not depend on the firmware file name. This also means that the same updater can be shared among all boards and can live outside of the private-overlay. * Testability of the firmware updater components and logic. For a component that is critical to system security, testability should be top priority. The new updater has been written in a semi-abstract manor that allows for testing of the update logic. * Ability to add metrics reporting about the update process and firmware versions encountered in the wild. Note that this change does not currently enable metrics. Minimal unit-tests of the firmware file version decoder have been included, but more in-depth tests of all components will follow. tast: Add -readfile flag to "tast list". To make it possible to decide which tests to run from outside of Tast (e.g. in a scheduling system), add a -readfile flag to the "list" subcommand that can be used to read JSON arrays of testing.Test structs (e.g. as produced by bundles' -dumptests flag) from a file instead of fetching tests from a DUT. Multiple instances of the flag can be passed to make it easier to provide tests from multiple bundles. This change also adds a new NoFinalize option that can be passed to testing.NewRegistry to indicate that added tests should not be validated or auto-filled (since this change requires adding serialized tests that were already finalized in the bundle). biod: Switch to brillo's log file management fn Brillo's version of UpdateLogSymlinks is nearly identical to the local version. Switching to brillo's version adds the errno string to the error message, but removes the sanity check that all files are in the same directory. In this case, the sanity check is not needed, since we explicitly derive all paths from the same log directory path. Brillo's GetTimeAsLogString is functionally equivalent to the local GetTimeAsString. The UpdateLogSymlinks code in biod was added in 2016 and brillo's version was added in 2017. Other projects have already made the switch to using brillo's version. BUG=chromium:952548 TEST=deployed and manually verified Change-Id: I5821861b2fecdba067e89db2a03ddbc569ef5031 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1565774 Commit-Ready: Craig Hesling <hesling@chromium.org> Tested-by: Craig Hesling <hesling@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Nicolas Norvez <norvez@chromium.org>

FROMLIST: mwifiex: Make resume actually do something useful again on SDIO cards The commit fc3a2fcaa1ba ("mwifiex: use atomic bitops to represent adapter status variables") had a fairly straightforward bug in it. It contained this bit of diff: - if (!adapter->is_suspended) { + if (test_bit(MWIFIEX_IS_SUSPENDED, &adapter->work_flags)) { As you can see the patch missed the "!" when converting to the atomic bitops. This meant that the resume hasn't done anything at all since that commit landed and suspend/resume for mwifiex SDIO cards has been totally broken. After fixing this mwifiex suspend/resume appears to work again, at least with the simple testing I've done. cr50: default to SPI PLT_RST if there's a pullup on DIOA9 The PLT_RST_L SYS_RST_L detection is critical to booting, so we need to have a way to make that decision for SPI boards even if there isn't a matching config in the board properties table. We keep adding SPI PLT_RST configs. Everytime we do we have to immediately add a new config to the strap table, because SPI straps aren't able to default to PLT_RST_L. This change adds support for defaulting to PLT_RST_L if there is a pullup on DIOA9. With this new logic there will be 8 supported configs that default to SPI PLT_RST_L and 4 that default to SPI SYS_RST_L. BUG=b:129866334 BRANCH=cr50, cr50-guc TEST=remove atlas config from the table.
